us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: US futures rise as crude prices retreat from recent gains
bullets: US stock futures rose early Friday as oil prices pulled back.
Brent crude had jumped above $104 on Thursday.
Markets remain sensitive to energy prices and inflation concerns.

articles.title: Trump says US will not resume Iran strikes before midterms
bullets: President Trump ruled out renewed Iran strikes before November 3.
The statement came amid heightened Middle East tensions.
Oil prices had risen sharply on conflict concerns.

articles.title: FCC weighs loosening political robocall rules, including AI voices
bullets: The FCC is considering a request on political robocalls.
The proposal includes calls using AI-generated voices.
A decision could come before the midterm elections.

articles.title: Republicans return to tough-on-crime message before midterms
bullets: GOP campaigns are emphasizing crime ahead of elections.
Ads warn about Democrats and policing policy.
Candidates are citing lower violent-crime levels.

articles.title: Trump campaigns in Nebraska to reassure GOP voters on economy
bullets: Trump visited Nebraska during a pre-midterm campaign blitz.
AP-NORC polling shows fuel-cost concerns have risen.
Republicans are defending seats in a difficult election environment.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major international developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Paris meeting to discuss Gaza’s post-war transition
bullets: France is hosting ministers from Europe, Arab states and others.
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan is expected to attend.
The talks focus on Gaza’s post-war transition.

articles.title: Malaysia’s Anwar to present 2027 budget to parliament
bullets: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim is scheduled to present the budget.
Reuters listed the budget as a major October 9 event.
Markets are watching fiscal and economic policy signals.

articles.title: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer makes first official India visit
bullets: Starmer’s India visit focuses on trade, technology and security.
He is scheduled to appear at Mumbai’s Global Fintech Fest.
The visit follows efforts to deepen UK-India ties.

articles.title: Thieves steal 30,000 wine bottles worth €5 million in Italy
bullets: Reports say thieves targeted a Florence-based winery.
About 30,000 bottles were stolen.
The haul was valued around €5 million.

articles.title: Israeli settlers install flagpoles outside Palestinian shop in West Bank
bullets: Reuters documented the incident in the West Bank.
Images showed flagpoles installed outside a Palestinian shop.
The report comes amid continuing regional tensions.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: India steps up Delhi security ahead of voter-list protest
bullets: Authorities increased security in New Delhi on Friday.
Transport restrictions were announced before a planned protest.
Demonstrators oppose a contentious voter-list revision.

articles.title: Delhi trains cancelled ahead of CJP protest
bullets: Indian Railways cancelled trains to New Delhi and Nizamuddin stations.
The cancellations run for 10 hours on October 10.
Officials linked the move to protest-related security arrangements.

articles.title: Seven killed, 20 injured in Gujarat’s Kutch road accident
bullets: The crash occurred near Khavda in Gujarat’s Kutch district.
Police said victims were in a pickup truck.
The accident happened between 3 a.m. and 4 a.m.

articles.title: Armed Forces to assess higher Agniveer retention
bullets: The services will review Agniveer reabsorption and resettlement.
The assessment follows the first batches exiting service.
The current retention cap stands at 25%.

articles.title: By-election counting under way for five Assembly seats and one Lok Sabha seat
bullets: Votes are being counted in six by-election contests.
Seats include Nandigram, Rejinagar, Madurantakam and Nagaon.
Results will test national and regional party strength.

articles.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq fall as chip stocks weigh
bullets: US stocks dipped Thursday after recent records.
Semiconductor shares pressured the Nasdaq.
Oil-price gains added inflation and rate concerns.

articles.title: Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron slide amid AI-stock weakness
bullets: Nvidia fell 2.9% in Thursday trading.
Broadcom dropped 4.3%, while Micron lost 4.8%.
AI-linked shares weighed on broader technology indexes.

articles.title: Humana jumps in Friday premarket trading
bullets: Humana rose 14.59% in premarket trading.
Shares traded near $443.61 before the open.
The move ranked among the day’s largest premarket gainers.

articles.title: Crown Castle leads large-cap premarket gainers
bullets: Crown Castle rose 8.11% in premarket trading.
PremarketPrice listed it as the top premarket gainer.
The site reported no clear catalyst for the move.

articles.title: AT&T ranks as biggest premarket decliner
bullets: AT&T fell 7.15% in premarket trading.
PremarketPrice flagged the move as unusually large.
The listed catalyst category was legal or regulatory.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economic stories moving business headlines

articles.title: US suspends several firms from green-card sponsorship program
bullets: The US froze some Green Card filings by eight firms.
TCS and Infosys were among affected companies reported in India.
The administration cited alleged visa-program abuse and fraud.

articles.title: Microsoft, Adobe and Cognizant named in US worker-residency suspension coverage
bullets: Reuters reported several tech firms were suspended from the program.
Techmeme listed Microsoft, Adobe and Cognizant among affected companies.
The program helps skilled foreign workers seek permanent residency.

articles.title: Africa’s biggest IPO highlights cross-border investing barriers
bullets: Reuters reported on Africa’s largest IPO.
The story focused on cross-border investing obstacles.
Market access remains a key issue for African capital markets.

articles.title: AI-spending worries weigh on global stocks
bullets: Investors are reassessing the cost of AI infrastructure.
Higher yields are increasing pressure on balance sheets.
Asian stocks were set for a second weekly drop.

articles.title: IMF-World Bank annual meetings preparations begin in Bangkok
bullets: Reuters listed preparations ahead of the 2026 meetings.
The IMF-World Bank annual meetings are scheduled in Bangkok.
Global finance officials are expected to gather there.

articles.title: OpenAI denies firing researchers for raising AI safety concerns
bullets: OpenAI responded to claims by three former researchers.
The company said departures involved sensitive-information policy violations.
The dispute drew attention across AI safety circles.

articles.title: Trump honors Musk, Huang, Su and Brin at White House innovation summit
bullets: Trump awarded top technology leaders National Medal of Science honors.
Recipients included Elon Musk, Jensen Huang and Lisa Su.
The event promoted US innovation and technology leadership.

articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077 to receive live-action movie adaptation
bullets: The video game is being adapted into a live-action film.
Paramount Pictures is attached to the project.
BBC listed the development among Friday’s top headlines.

articles.title: AI stocks fall after report on OpenAI annualized revenue
bullets: CNBC reported weakness in Nvidia, Oracle and CoreWeave.
The declines followed a report on OpenAI’s annualized revenue.
Investors scrutinized AI revenue and infrastructure spending assumptions.

articles.title: FCC considers allowing more AI-generated political robocalls
bullets: Regulators are reviewing political robocall restrictions.
The request includes AI-generated voice calls.
The decision could affect campaign technology before midterms.
